name: smwmusic-rick-astley-death-by-rick-roll-never-gonna-give-you-up-remix
title: Rick Astley - Death By Rick Roll ~ Never Gonna Give You Up (Remix)
description:
We're no strangers to love. You know the rules, and so do I.

Did an arrangement of Never Gonna Give You Up by Rick Astley.

If I ever find out that you give up, let her down, turn around, and desert her, I will come to your house and take your liver.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. A# Minor (Original Pitch, turned on default)
2. B Minor (Robo Pitch)
3. A Minor (Custom Pitch)
